Name: Asters Big Interior Mod
Author: Asterisk555
TagLine: All in one mod to retexture everything in the farmhouse
Description:
_Description:_

*   Sort of like a 'collection' of mods, for people who don't use Vortex

*   All in one modpack

*   Main purpose of the mod is so you can have __a lot__ of new ways to retexture your farmhouse in one neat <s>little</s> big bundle

*   This modpack allows you to change the beams, kitchen units, pillars, and log panels using CP.

*   Adds retextures to furniture items using AT

*   If you like this you could buy me a [coffee](https://ko-fi.com/asteriskart)﻿ to show your support or comment and say what you liked :3
_Quick start:_

1.  Download and extract the "Big Interior Suite" mod and it's requirements into your mods folder (if you are confused check out [this guide](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started)﻿).

2.  The mod will __mostly__ be ready to play. But several features will be switched off by default.

3.  One feature switched off by default is changes to the beams. The "Beams" folder handles changes to fixed farmhouse features, like beams, kitchens and stairs. Inside the "example config with screenshots" folder there are pictures to help you choose what settings you want, with configs.json files you can just copy and paste in  in the "[CP] Asters Beam Mod" folder to make your farmhouse look like what's in the picture.

4.  For other items like furniture, buy the paintbucket from Robin's shop. I have a video on [how to use AT on my tools retexture page](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9984)﻿.
_Config guide:_

Beams:

*   The "Beams" folder handles changes to fixed farmhouse features, like beams, kitchens and stairs. Inside the "example config with screenshots" folder there are pictures to help you choose what settings you want, with configs.json files you can just copy and paste in  in the "[CP] Asters Beam Mod" folder to make your farmhouse look like what's in the picture.

*   Your options are usually just the filenames of the images, so you have to go into the "Assets" folder and copy the filenames into the config file. So for example if you want to change the "logpanels" you got to the ""[CP] Asters Big Interior Mod\assets\logpanels" folder and copy the name of the logpanel you want and type it next to "logpanel_near_stairs". 

*   You don't have to put something in every field, you can just leave them empty if you don't want to change them.

*   All items of the same type end with the same word, so the "Find and Replace" feature of a word processor can be useful. For example if I want all the kitchens to be the same I find [Kitchen": "] and replace it with [Kitchen": "vanilla_configguide]
Kitchens:

*   This modpack includes a file that removes the built in kitchen and mails you your kitchen after you upgrade the farmhouse instead. You can also buy kitchen pieces from Robin.

*   If you decide to delete "No Built In Kitchen" then you can use "[CP] Asters Beam Mod" to retexture the kitchen instead. Some of the kitchens in "[CP] Asters Beam Mod" are taller than the original vanilla tilesheet, so you need to use the AT logpanels to fit in the missing pieces like a puzzle. The files will be tagged with the name of the kitchen they're matched to.
Furniture:

*   This modpack adds kitchens and spouse furniture to various shops (and also turns spouse rooms into empty rooms)

*   All other furniture can be accessed by using the paint bucket tool (purchasable from Robin) to paint vanilla items

*   The furniture conversion only retextures a limited number of items because the search feature of Alternative Textures is more useful that way. So, for example, even if this mod has 10 different kinds of chairs they will all retexture the "Oak Chair" rather than being spread around to retexture a bunch of different chairs.

*   Some features from the original mod releases will be lost since AT is only a visual format, but this is a good way to see all the art in one place.

*   I've released almost everything in this modpack as other smaller mods, so if you like some of the stuff in this modpack but want to pick and choose you can [check out my other mods](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/71424903?tab=user+files)

_Modular version of this mod_
Further details on the component parts of this modpack can be found in these mod pages. This modpack __only__ has art that I've previously released in other mods. This means if you want to you could downloads parts of this modpack and leave other bits out. These are some of the mods which were merged to create this one:

*   [Beams, kitchens, and logpanels](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11597)

*   [Wallpaper and Flooring Megapack](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12002) 

*   [Buildable Kitchen](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11950) and [No Built In Kitchen](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12120)﻿

*   [Big Alternative Textures Furniture Pack](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12240), and [Chests and minifridges as baskets](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12219)﻿﻿﻿

*   [Customisable Empty Spouse Rooms](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11641) (can be swapped out for [bathroom replaces spouseroom](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12150) and [spouseroom furniture](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12187)﻿ instead)

*   [Alternative Textures Tool Retexture](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9984)﻿

*   [Brullov's fire animation](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11846)﻿ (optional transparent core version)

*   [Alternative Textures shop](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13078)﻿

_Compatibility:
_This modpack prioritises high compatibility with other mods and should be compatible with mods that add furniture and wallpaper items. The parts that may be incompatible with modded farmhouses are "no built in kitchen", which you can remove.

*   Mainly only changes things to do with the Farmhouse interior, and other farm building interiors

*   Mostly aesthetic changes only

*   If anything looks weird with this mod installed it's usually an easy fix, and even if you ignore it it won't stop you being able to play
_Art Credit:_
Big thanks to everyone who's given me permission to add their art to this mod! I have asked and received permission from each of the people listed below to be allowed to receive DP from this mod.

*   Some of the wood panel art and colour palettes come from [Krissymarie's Woods Wainscotting Walls and Floors mod](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6851). This mod was initially designed to complement that one so if you like this one go give that one some love! There is also an [Alternatives Textures conversion](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9869)﻿﻿. 

*   The plaid and checker patterns are based on files given to me by [billi](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/106750543?tab=user+files)﻿, who's made some really cute mods you should check out like [Rural Outfitters](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10295)﻿.

*   In future I will also be adding a bed based on [Aura](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/108217533)﻿'s [Japanese Furniture](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10212)﻿, so check out her stuff!

*   [Kedi](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/profile/225898)﻿ has also given me permission to make an interior inspired by her [Sweetry Buildings & Craftables](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/1073455-sweetry-buildings-and-craftables)﻿, which is a future planned update.
_Updates I'd like to make:_

*   Sweetry kitchen and waffle beams

*   More cottagecore, 60s, Japanese, royalcore, gaming, and bohemian furniture

*   Nicer cots and some halfpanel retextures

*   Joja interiors, brick beams

*   stain glass logpanels/windows
